svg.title: Site checklist — each floor separately
svg.desc: Review is complete without inventing field measurements
svg.text: Site checklist — each floor separately
Civil coordination · review only · all site dimensions require verification
SHEET 4 / 4
house-design.json
79ece2aef1acd63ee4017021…
COPY FOR EACH STOREY
Master instances F1-F4 are placeholders: actual G / 1 / 2 / 3 labels and floor differences are not confirmed.
MASON / SITE SURVEY
Record room internal dimensions, wall thicknesses, openings, lintel/sill/head heights and
door swings; photograph and label each room.
Reconcile dining 110.6 mm, living 145.1 mm and master 41.1 mm model assembly residuals.
These are not measured gaps; do not fill or move walls from the model.
Confirm actual D01 leaf count, W03 offsets, W05 size, both toilet hinges and utility
parapet / corner height.
CEILING / JOINERY
Survey FFL, slab underside, band, centre-panel level, beam soffit and bath / utility / lobby
ceilings; record measured floor-finish and slab thickness.
Mock up curtain pocket, two tracks, brackets, stack and the selected profile; MBR-S / CBR
modeled returns cross room boundaries, so coordinate actual ends.
Measure wardrobe, loft soffit / depth and shutter clearance. Keep the approved split layout
in principle; do not fabricate placeholder dimensions.
Dressing cabinet ST-R04a-WR01: measure clear width and door / route clearance (FH-ST-03).
Utility cabinet ST-R08-UC01: measure geometry and service access (FH-ST-12). Both selections
remain conditional.
ELECTRICIAN / LIGHTING
Fixed CCT is assigned by fitting; coves and the four selected S1 strips are 2700 K. LOW
mood and HIGH general use local controls.
CBR-H1-H6 are active/switchable at accepted positions. C37 dimmer and the exact fitting /
driver / control chain are procurement holds, not construction release.
Confirm supply access, cable routes, wet-zone protection, product fit and each pocket
mock-up. W03 strip is held; pooja lights are allowances only.
Living LOW uses one selected P01 supply concept (24 V, 480 W nameplate); no product is
approved. The 20 A supply reference exceeds a candidate controller input of 12.5 A. Hold
controller / repeater, distribution, branch protection and inrush for electrical design.
STRUCTURAL / SITE PROFESSIONAL
Review stair rise, going, landings, headroom and guard against applicable local requirements
on every storey.
Verify existing niche extension, platform fixing, fire clearance, load capacity and loft
supports; no new cutting or deepening authorised.
Measure actual tenant bed frame and study return: the 387.6 mm R05 model pinch is not a
comfortable route. Keep selected layout; escalate only with measured consequences.
OPEN HOMEOWNER DESIGN CHOICE VS SITE / PROFESSIONAL HOLD
Open design choice recorded in the master: pooja niche back / base finish. Small idols with a framed picture behind and the approximate platform intent are already selected; exact placement is
a site coordination matter.
Do not re-ask the HD-15 furniture layout, the four S1 strips, fixed CCT, CBR-H1-H6 or the split-wardrobe concept. Measurements, code compliance, product compatibility, capacities and formal
professional approvals remain open.
